# DiapoLab

> A futuristic presentation and design editor for creating bold multipage slides, posters, and social graphics.

DiapoLab is a browser-based design tool. Users build multipage designs on a canvas with text, shapes, icons, images, AI-generated assets, interactive quizzes, and animated timelines, then export to PNG, PDF, PPTX, HTML, MP4, or JSON. Signed-in users can save designs to the cloud and publish them as community templates.

## Pages

- [Editor](/): The main design and presentation editor.
- [Sign in](/auth): Sign in or create an account to save and sync designs.
- [Settings](/settings): Edit the editor settings.
- [Marketplace](/marketplace): Find themes and templates.
